# Surface

> Surface is a pay-per-request URL preflight for AI agents. Before an agent fetches a URL a user pasted (especially t.co, bit.ly, lnkd.in, youtu.be), call Surface: it unwraps redirects and returns next: "fetch" or "skip". It never returns the page body. The first 1M requests/month are free; after that it's $0.25 USD per 1k preflights (Hop $0.40, Pixel $0.15, Inspect $0.20 per 1k).

## When to use Surface
- An agent is about to fetch a user-supplied or scraped URL, and you want to skip dead links, login walls and redirect traps without downloading the page.
- You want to unwrap short links to see the final host before opening them.
- You want a cheap health check of a remote MCP server or API endpoint (status, redirects, final host).

## Quick start
- Optional free API key (no card): POST https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/v1/keys returns {"key":"surf_..."}, or sign up at https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/start#key
- Send it as Authorization: Bearer surf_... (or X-Surface-Key: surf_...). Usage: GET https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/v1/usage
- MCP (streamable HTTP): https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/mcp with tool preflight_url {"url": "..."}
- REST: GET https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/v1/preflight?url=<url>
- REST: POST https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/v1/preflight with JSON {"url": "..."}
- CORS is open. The key is optional: keyless calls still work, limited to 60 per minute, and include a get_key note.
